sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 11 (#10 verifier_is_isolated_pinned_and_credentialed); Internal Quality Checks row 11 (older 'pinned image + allowlist' wording, superseded by public row 'Network is public - no allowlist required'); Deterministic Checks C7, C11, C29; Quality rows 22/47 for scope boundaries
evidence: task/task.toml:26-28 sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate" (timeout_sec 13200.0); lines 30-35 [verifier.env] are REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" - byte-identical to staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71, and `diff` of the [verifier]..EOF section against the frozen template task.toml is empty; lines 37-38 [verifier.environment] network_mode="public" (no allowlist required per public row). task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (sha256 72998ab8...): version-tagged bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim, npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; it COPYs its own /tests and chmod go-rwx; apt packages unpinned (deterministic C11 treats as NOTE). environment/Dockerfile also identical to template and carries no tests/solution/key. All five judge.toml files carry only judge="claude-code" (matching REWARDKIT_JUDGE) with no model/temperature/effort key (grep for 'model =' returned nothing). test.sh is identical to template and refuses to run if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL are unset (lines 63-64); no task file overrides the model or embeds a key. Weak/alternative probes: a task that added a model to judge.toml or changed REWARDKIT_MODEL/base URL would fail here; none present. A conforming alternative cannot be failed by this wiring because it is template-identical. Base images are tag-pinned not digest-pinned, but that is template-controlled and the skill's 'pinned bases' is satisfied by explicit version tags. Scope note: no full configured verifier launch with real OPENROUTER_API_KEY exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says so); that runtime gap belongs to the launch/grading runtime records and rows 22/47, not to this static wiring row, which is fully verifiable from source. The functional judge.toml mode/timeout change (individual/550) is a timeout-row matter, not credentials/pinning.
